selection_rule.1_bug_test: The spec passes skills/tdd-cycle/SKILL.md's bug test: **Type:** Bug, an Origin citing .writ/issues/bugs/, or a Fix title.
selection_rule.2_fix_commit: A product-code fix(...) commit is matched to the spec by hand; fix(tests) and fix(ci) commits do not count. One fix_commit_note per story says why that commit is the fix.
selection_rule.3_phase11_rules: The Phase 11 rules hold except commit lookup: the story is Completed, the commit has a parent, it touches at least one test file outside tests/integration/ and tests/e2e/, and those files import no prisma, stripe, @neondatabase, or next-auth module unless they jest.mock() it.
selection_rule.4_take: Of the admitted stories, the four most recent by fix-commit date are taken.
selection_rule.5_prepare_inputs: The story file and its spec's contract section exist at the fix commit (what prepare reads).

selection.fix_commit_note: Fix-type commit in the event-cover area that lands the product change, its unit test, and the spec, whose Type field marks a bug fix; story 1 is the spec's only story.
Fix-type dashboard commit with one unit test; the spec lands in the same commit and its Origin cites a bug issue file.
One commit lands the bug-fix spec with all three of its stories and their changes; story 1 holds the counting fix, so it is the story under trial.
